name: fade-in
title: Fade in
description: Reveal content on scroll with a short rise and a reduced-motion fallback.
docs:
## When to use - Section intros, cards, and empty states that should arrive when they enter the viewport. - Anywhere you want one consistent entrance instead of hand-writing `whileInView` per element. - Marketing pages where a short rise adds reading rhythm without delaying content. ## When not to use - Content that is already visible on first paint and must not move (use no animation). - Long lists where every row would animate at once; use a stagger container instead. - Replacing layout or routing transitions; this only animates its own children. ## Installation ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/fade-in ``` This pulls in `cadence-motion`, `cadence-utils`, and `cadence-provider` automatically. ## Usage ```tsx import { FadeIn } from "@/components/cadence/fade-in/fade-in"; export function Feature() { return (

Ignored when motion is reduced. | | `distance` | `number` | `12` | Pixels travelled while fading in. | | `once` | `boolean` | `true` | Reveal once, or replay on every viewport entry. | | `className` | `string` | – | Merged with the wrapper classes. | | `children` | `ReactNode` | – | Content to reveal. | ## Motion contract | Phase | Properties | Token | Interruptible | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | enter | `opacity 0 → 1`, `translateY distance → 0` | `reveal` (0.22s, ease-out) | n/a (one-shot) | | reduced | `opacity` only, 0.16s | `reveal` short | n/a | | none | end state immediately | – | n/a | ## Keyboard interactions No keyboard behaviour of its own. Focus order and semantics are unchanged. ## Accessibility - Never hides content permanently: opacity reaches `1` and the element stays in the DOM. - The wrapper is a `div`; pass `as`-style semantics by nesting the correct element, or use your own wrapper. - Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`; with reduce enabled only opacity animates. ## Responsive behavior Distance is in pixels, not viewport units, so the motion stays subtle on mobile. Use a larger `distance` only for full-width hero blocks. ## Performance - Animates `opacity` and `transform` only, on the compositor. - One `IntersectionObserver` per instance, no scroll listeners. - Prefer `once` for long pages so observers disconnect after the first reveal. ## Notes for AI - Default entrance for a single block. For lists, keep the stagger on the parent and use small values (≤ 0.06s per item). - Do not wrap above-the-fold hero text that must be readable before hydration. - If the design already animates the parent, nest `FadeIn` only for the child that needs its own timing.
